summary: Built the minimal FastAPI Module 1 service in a single-app layout with centralized environment validation and a working health endpoint.
evidence: Created API_ROOT at api/ for the single-app layout.
Added api/.env.example with placeholders for PORT, DATABASE_URL, MONGODB_URI, REDIS_URL, JWT_SECRET, API_KEY_A, and API_KEY_B.
Added api/.env for local execution and kept it out of git via api/.gitignore.
Created api/app/config.py to load settings from .env and fail fast when PORT is missing, non-numeric, or outside 1..65535.
Created api/app/main.py with a FastAPI app and GET /health returning {"ok": true, "port": 8000}.
Created a local virtual environment in api/.venv and installed FastAPI, uvicorn, pydantic-settings, and python-dotenv.
Verified the healthy startup path with curl.exe http://127.0.0.1:8000/health returning {"ok":true,"port":8000}.
Ran the required failure-first drill with PORT=abc and confirmed startup failed before serving traffic with the message Invalid PORT. Set PORT in .env to an integer between 1 and 65535.
Ran the required boundary-value drill with PORT=70000 and confirmed startup failed before serving traffic with the same clear invalid PORT message.
Restored PORT=8000, restarted the app, and re-verified GET /health returned {"ok":true,"port":8000}.
